rows.note: Use this for facilities, buildings, websites, or services designed so disabled people can use them.

example.english: This mall has accessible routes, so it is convenient even for wheelchair users.
example.traditional: 呢個商場有無障礙通道，坐輪椅都方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng1 coeng4 jau5 mou4 zoeng3 ngoi6 tung1 dou6 co5 leon4 ji2 dou1 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this for a place that is easy to get to or reach; it is the all-purpose choice for the physical-access sense.

example.english: The new restaurant is accessible by MTR.
example.traditional: 新嗰間餐廳搭地鐵好容易去到。
example.jyutping: san1 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 daap3 dei6 tit3 hou2 jung4 ji6 heoi3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a person who is easy to get along with and approachable in social interaction.

example.english: Ming is very accessible, and you can talk to him about any problem.
example.traditional: 阿明好相處，有咩問題都可以同佢傾。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hou2 soeng1 cyu5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 dou1 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 king1
